nodes.name: Log and sign report
nodes.notes: Only workflow name, node name, execution id and the error message leave n8n. No item data, so no user data ends up in the log.

nodes.name: Report to Convex automation log
nodes.notes: Idempotent on executionId. If Convex is unreachable too, the failure is still visible in n8n's own execution list (error executions are always saved).
